jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company s products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.  CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com . The Role You’ll join a small, highly collaborative team working across London and San Francisco, building the software behind some of the world’s most advanced radar systems. Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, and the teams who take these systems into the field, you’ll design the backend services, data pipelines, and operator-facing applications that turn raw sensor data into decisions people can act on. The systems you build must be reliable, resilient, secure, and performant - enabling operators to depend on them in the environments where they matter most. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll influence architecture and help define the engineering foundations of a rapidly evolving platform. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy scaling distributed systems and solving hard data problems. What You’ll Build Backend Services  - develop high-performance Python services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data with low latency, high reliability, and security at scale. Operator Interfaces  - build and evolve the web applications operators use to monitor live missions and investigate what the sensors saw (TypeScript and React). Cloud Platform  - design and build secure, scalable Azure services that power distributed radar systems

jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Software Engineer, SDK
jobs.description: Why SDK Engineering at Langfuse Your work will have an outsized impact. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our SDKs . We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation. Designing APIs that developers love . How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. jobs.description: As a GNC/AOCS Engineer at Spire, you will operate as part of a technical team who maintains responsibility across the full lifecycle of its engineering products. The GNC team interfaces directly with many engineering groups to conduct R&D, design, manufacturing, and operations activities, ultimately ensuring all current and future spacecraft systems satisfy their mission. Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years! What You'll Do: Technical ownership of current and future spacecraft attitude and orbit control software and hardware. Design, model, analyze, integrate and operate attitude determination/estimation systems for small spacecraft. Develop and utilize spacecraft dynamics and control simulations, including 'hardware-in-the-loop'. Design, evaluate, select, qualify and implement flight sensors, including magnetometers, sun sensors, inertial measurement devices, infrared sensors, and/or star trackers. Design, evaluate, select, qualify and implement flight actuators, including magnetic torque elements, reaction wheels, and propulsion systems. Be hands-on in laboratory and manufacturing environments during testing, integration, and qualification of flight systems. Provide support and analysis for on-orbit operations of spacecraft attitude determination and control systems. Work with external contractors, manufacturers, and internal manufacturing staff to improve reliability, yield, performance, and cost of flight systems. Key Skills: Extensive experience with a solid foundation in spacecraft attitude dynamics and control algorithms, with emphasis on practical application of knowledge. jobs.description: About The Company GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house. Our collective of smart, curious people think differently and live by a shared mission, purpose, vision, and values. These shape how we work, not just with our colleagues, but with clients and partners too. We do this by igniting and empowering the potential of every individual within our company, recognising that each person is a unique spark, capable of creating extraordinary impact. We believe that by nurturing and harnessing the collective brilliance of our people, we can drive innovation, foster an uncommon work culture, and make a positive difference to society. Embracing the complete range of skills and services across the communications spectrum without constraint, we create the best outcomes for our clients and deliver world-class work. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them. In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows. You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses. Notre culture Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience . jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in de huidige manier van werken rondom hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s binnen NPD Mechanical Engineering. Op dit moment worden de schema’s opgesteld op een manier die niet-configureerbaar is en beperkte mogelijkheden biedt, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het printen en hergebruiken van coderingen. Je onderzoekt hoe EPLAN Fluid het beste ingezet kan worden om de huidige aanpak eventueel te vervangen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar “hoe het kan”, maar vooral naar “hoe het moet”. Je werkt hierbij samen met engineers en krijgt de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Je sluit af met een proof of concept: een volledig hydraulisch en pneumatisch machineschema dat als referentie kan dienen voor nieuwe machineontwikkeling. Mogelijke onderdelen van je opdracht: In kaart brengen van de huidige werkwijze en knelpunten rond hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s; Opstellen van een gestandaardiseerde werkwijze; Verkennen van configuratie- en documentatiemogelijkheden binnen EPLAN Fluid; Bouwen van een proof of concept als referentie; Opleveren van een korte handleiding en overdracht naar de engineers. Wij vragen Een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. jobs.title: Afstuderen Artificial Intelligence: Ontwikkel de AI-generator voor Account Business Reviews
jobs.description: WAT GA JE DOEN? Account Business Reviews (ABR’s) vormen de rode draad in de gesprekken tussen onze accountmanagers en klanten. Tijdens deze periodieke meetings staan de samenwerking, prestaties, aandachtspunten, kansen en gezamenlijke vervolgstappen centraal. De voorbereiding kost nu veel tijd, omdat relevante informatie uit verschillende systemen en bronnen handmatig moet worden verzameld en samengevoegd. Jouw uitdaging is om te onderzoeken hoe informatie uit verschillende systemen binnen een veilige en gecontroleerde omgeving automatisch kan worden samengebracht en verwerkt tot een professioneel ABR-rapport. AI helpt bij het structureren, samenvatten en formuleren van relevante inzichten, aanbevelingen en onderwerpen voor het komende gesprek. Zo help je accountmanagers om beter voorbereid en met meer focus aan tafel te zitten. Ook na de meeting speelt AI een belangrijke rol. Je onderzoekt hoe gesprekken efficiënt kunnen worden samengevat, hoe besluiten en actiepunten worden vastgelegd en hoe de gemaakte afspraken terugkomen in het rapport of in een bevestiging aan de klant. De uiteindelijke oplossing staat niet vooraf vast. Jij bepaalt op basis van gebruikersbehoeften, beschikbare data, AI-mogelijkheden en technische haalbaarheid welke aanpak het beste bij Voortman past. BEOOGD RESULTAAT Het beoogde resultaat is een onderbouwd advies met een gevalideerd AI-concept of prototype voor het ABR-proces. De oplossing ondersteunt de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van klantgesprekken en laat zien hoe informatie uit verschillende bronnen kan worden omgezet in een bruikbaar rapport, concrete afspraken en heldere klantcommunicatie. De aanpak moet praktisch toepasbaar, betrouwbaar en schaalbaar zijn binnen Voortman. Wij vragen Hbo- of Wo-opleiding in de richting van Business IT & Management, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Commerciële Economie, Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde of vergelijkbaar. Je bent handig met AI en hebt affiniteit met data, procesverbetering

jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. jobs.title: Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über LIFTED Mit LIFTED bauen wir die neue Go-to-Marke für Krafttraining auf. In einer Welt voller Longevity Quick Fixes und exklusiver Fitness-Trends konzentrieren wir uns auf einen der wichtigsten Faktoren für ein langes und gesundes Leben: Krafttraining. Unsere Studios machen Krafttraining einfach, effektiv und messbar – für Menschen, die stärker werden wollen, sich in klassischen Fitnessstudios aber nicht zuhause fühlen. Der Trainingsfortschritt wird digital erfasst, während unsere Trainer jedes Mitglied individuell unterstützen und für ein motivierendes Trainingserlebnis sorgen. Hinter LIFTED steht ein erfahrenes Founding Team mit tiefem Know-how in der Fitnessbranche & dem Aufbau von Offline Operations. Gemeinsam haben wir BEAT81 von Grund auf aufgebaut und auf 35 Standorte skaliert. Jetzt entwickeln wir Krafttraining mit LIFTED neu – und bauen die nächste große Fitnessmarke auf. In den vergangenen 18 Monaten haben wir 6 Studios in Berlin eröffnet. Bis Ende 2026 werden wir neun Standorte betreiben. Ab 2027 planen wir, jährlich mehr als 12 neue Studios in deutschen Großstädten zu eröffnen. Um dieses Konzept weiter auszubauen, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d). Über die Rolle Unsere TrainerInnen sind das Herz von LIFTED. Sie bringen unseren KundInnnen die Grundlagen des Krafttrainings bei, helfen ihnen dabei Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und bieten ein einzigartiges Trainingserlebnis. Und genau die Menschen, die das möglich machen, suchen wir. Als Werkstudent im Trainer Recruiting spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Wachstum von LIFTED. Du findest talentierte TrainerInnen, begeisterst sie für uns und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Tryout im Studio. Mit jedem neuen Studio wächst unser Team – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wer Teil davon wird. Aufgaben Active Sourcing Du findest passende Trainer:innen in ganz Deutschland über Instagram, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle , sprichst sie direkt an und machst sie neugierig auf LIFTED.

jobs.title: Controller (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Head of Finance – Teilzeit möglich
jobs.description: Über Cellagon Du hast in einem Startup oder bei einer wachsenden Marke gelernt, wie aus Ware Zahlen werden, und willst jetzt nicht nur berichten, sondern ein Unternehmen mitgestalten? Cellagon ist 40 Jahre alt und tickt wie ein Startup. Seit 1986 machen wir Mikronährstoffkonzentrate, entwickelt und hergestellt in Deutschland. Unser Herz sind mehr als 15.000 begeisterte Partnerinnen und Partner in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz, die unsere Produkte persönlich weiterempfehlen. So arbeiten wir: ein Team aus rund 35 Leuten, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und KI-Werkzeuge überall dort, wo sie uns die Arbeit leichter machen. Was dazu noch fehlt: jemand, der unsere Zahlen in die Hand nimmt. Wir suchen dich als Controller mit Perspektive Head of Finance, in Teilzeit ab 30 Stunden oder in Vollzeit, remote mit regelmäßigen Treffen im Raum Düsseldorf. Bevor du weiterliest, solltest du zwei Dinge wissen. Bei uns ist noch nicht alles fertig: Vieles steckt in gewachsenen Excel-Dateien, und genau dort kannst du vom ersten Tag an etwas bewegen. Außerdem ist unser Firmensitz in Altenholz bei Kiel. Du arbeitest remote. Wir treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich im Raum Düsseldorf, deshalb solltest du in NRW wohnen, idealerweise in der Nähe von Düsseldorf. Deine Aufgaben Du bewertest jeden Monat unsere Bestände an mehreren Lagerorten und gleichst sie mit unserem ERP-System ab. Du übernimmst das Einkaufscontrolling: Einstandspreise, Preisüberwachung und Kalkulation je Produkt. Du übersetzt unsere Einkaufs- und Produktionsplanung in Zahlungen und pflegst damit die Liquiditätsplanung. Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss gemeinsam mit unserem Buchhaltungsteam (DATEV) vor und steuerst ihn. Du erstellst unseren monatlichen Management-Report mit Deckungsbeitragsrechnung und Kennzahlen. Du ersetzt Handarbeit durch Automatisierung und KI, wo es sinnvoll ist. Du koordinierst Budget und Planung mit den Fachbereichen. Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in die Finanzleitung hinein: Jahresabschlus

jobs.description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. jobs.description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling. What you'll build and own Own user acquisition targets for Pakistan end to end - online and offline - and be accountable for the numbers, not just the effort. Build and execute acquisition strategies tailored to the Pakistani community, using data and insight to optimise against KPIs and cut what is not working fast. Lead community-driven initiatives - events, meetups, forums - that build genuine trust and advocacy for LemFi, not just brand awareness for its own sake.

As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands. Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. jobs.description: SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry. By catering to both fans and rightsholders, we're powering a new, open entertainment ecosystem where fans have effortless access to experiences, and venues have seamless access to their audiences. Because everyone should expect more from ticketing. Most fans don't start their ticket search on SeatGeek. They start with a conversation with ChatGPT, a Google search, an Instagram ad, a team's website, an email, or a link from a friend. What happens in the first few seconds after they land decides whether they find their tickets with us or go back to searching. Today that journey spans many surface areas and responsible teams. We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to focus on the end to end experience, from the first touchpoint through landing and onto the event page, including fans who leave and come back. Once fans land, you'll also own the consistency of the features that follow them across every surface, such as price display and fee transparency, credits and incentives, notifications, saved and followed events, and our guarantee and trust signals. Fans meet these everywhere, yet no single team owns them. This role doesn't have its own squad. You'll deliver through other teams' roadmaps. That means setting the strategy, making the case, and partnering closely with PMs, engineering and design leads, and marketers to turn a fragmented journey into one experience. If you're energized by impact through influence rather than direct ownership of a single surface, this role is for you. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Overview: As an Engineering Manager at Fanatics, you will be a technical leader with the ability to grow and scale engineering teams that can deliver business results and ship high-quality software for customer-facing products and internal platforms. jobs.title: Paytient Interest Application: Technical Roles
jobs.description: About Paytient : We’re on a mission to help people better access and afford care. Every day, millions of people, and their loved ones, need to see a doctor. For most of us, that moment is an uncertain one - we’re unsure of what’s wrong, who to go to, how long it’ll take to be seen, when we’ll feel better, and what it’ll cost. Paytient partners with thoughtful employers and health plans who understand the impact of that moment and want to ensure that every one of their plan members are easily able to access and afford care. Our clients understand that an improved ability to self-pay for care changes patient behavior and creates value for the health plan. This founding belief is becoming an emerging standard of care in health plan design and is now, in fact, a mandatory capability in some governmental health plans. Founded in 2018, Paytient is now part of nearly 6,000 employer health plans and providing certainty that people are better able to access and afford care. We’re looking for passionate, collaborative builders to join our team and help us create a future where everyone can more easily access and afford care. About The Role: Don't see any technical openings that suit your interests and skills? We're constantly creating new positions as we continue our mission of helping people better access and afford care. We're always excited to hear from talented technical folks -- interested in software engineering, data, product management, I.T., and beyond. Please submit your resume, and we'll follow up when there's a role that might suit you! Our “remote with roots” model allows us to work where we thrive and gather as needed, often in our home office in Columbia, Missouri. This role can be performed from anywhere in the continental U.S., with the exception of Montana. Benefits We Offer for Full-Time Roles: Medical, dental and vision insurance $4,400 annual HSA contribution Paytient Health Payment Account (HPA) Monthly lifestyle spending stipend Five weeks of annual PTO

jobs.title: AI Tech Lead, Remote (based in Europe)
jobs.description: Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. We're hiring our first AI Tech Lead to build the intelligence behind our coach: turning biometric and behavioural signals into personalised programmes that help people sleep better and stress less. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code. What you'll be doing 1) Signal interpretation: Turn wearable and in-app data into recovery, stress and sleep insights, using personal baselines and trend detection. 2) Multi-device data: Normalise metrics across vendors, weight sources by reliability, and handle missing data and device switches. 3) Recommendation engine: Personalise protocol sequences by dose and timing with classical ML (e.g. contextual bandits, sequential recommenders or RL). 4) Feedback loops: Learn from real user behaviour and biometric responses which protocols work, and for whom. 5) Evaluation: Offline metrics, online experiments and production monitoring for every model and LLM feature. 6) AI platform: Own the roadmap, training and serving pipelines, data quality and architecture on our Python and Azure stack. 7) Technical leadership: Make and own the key architecture and modelling decisions, and write them down (RFCs, ADRs etc.) so the team can build them. 8) Privacy: Make secure handling of sensitive health data part of the design from the start. 9) Collaboration: Help product, design and marketing shape AI features and understand what the models can and can't do. Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production. Requirements 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud Time series, recommend

À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. jobs.title: ML-Engineer (m/w/d) – Machine Learning für Recyclinganlagen
jobs.description: Digitalisierung ist deine Leidenschaft und du brennst für Nachhaltigkeit? Dann gestalte mit uns die digitale Transformation der Recyclingbranche! Die Eggersmann Gruppe ist ein international tätiger Verbund von Unternehmen mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung in Umwelttechnologien und mehr als 1.300 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Als führender Anbieter von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen treiben wir zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für eine funktionierende Kreislaufwirtschaft voran. Um die Potenziale der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung in der Recyclingbranche voll auszuschöpfen, haben wir in Aachen unseren digitalen Innovations-Hub als Corporate Start-up gegründet. Mit der ESA app, unserer modularen IIoT-Software, optimieren wir den Betrieb von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen durch Datenanalyse und Machine Learning. Deine Mission: Du machst Machine Learning produktionsreif: Du entwickelst skalierbare Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS und bringst Machine-Learning-Modelle zuverlässig in den Einsatz. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Anomalieerkennung in Zeitreihendaten von Recyclinganlagen. So trägst du dazu bei, Abweichungen frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen und den Anlagenbetrieb datenbasiert zu verbessern – von der technischen Infrastruktur bis zum laufenden Modellbetrieb. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest die Konzeption, Entwicklung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS, beispielsweise mit EC2, Lambda, S3 und CloudWatch. Du bringst Machine-Learning-Modelle in den produktiven Einsatz und entwickelst die dafür bestehenden Prozesse weiter – von Bereitstellung und Monitoring über AutoML-gestütztes Retraining bis hin zu CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Du entwirfst Datenmodelle, schreibst effiziente SQL-Abfragen für relationale Datenbanken und verantwortest die zugehörigen Datenbankmanagement-Aufgaben. Du entwickelst, trainierst, validierst und deployst Machine-Learning-Modelle mit Schwerpunkt auf der Anomalieerkennun

jobs.description: Job Title: Software Engineer - B2B Lending & Payments Type: Full-time Location: Paris What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 The Role We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT. We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. jobs.description: À propos de PropertyOS PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique. Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier. Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat. 🚀 Votre mission En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution. Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre : Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative. Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition. Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS. Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel. Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés. Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté. 💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance. La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus. Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS.

jobs.description: Poste : Technicien (position 2.1, coefficient 275, convention collective Syntec) · Basé en France · Interventions sur notre infrastructure, partout en France et à l'international Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde. Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore. Qui nous sommes Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays. Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays. Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. About The Role This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster

jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) adalah perusahaan pembiayaan yang bergerak di bidang pembiayaan mobil, motor, pembiayaan syariah, serta pinjaman multiguna. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF). MUF berdiri secara resmi pada tanggal 21 Januari 2015 dan telah terdaftar serta diawasi oleh Regulator Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 29/ POJK.05/2014. Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) merupakan perusahaan pembiayaan dimana merupakan salah satu anak perusahaan bank terbesar di Indonesia, yaitu Bank Mandiri Tbk. Orientasi bisnis MUF adalah peningkatan volume nasabah beserta pembiayaan yang signifikan, dengan dukungan otomatisasi sistem yang terintegrasi. Lowongan Kerja PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) Saat ini PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) memberikan kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: MUF Management Trainee (MMT) 2027 MUF Management Trainee (MMT) merupakan program pengembangan talenta unggulan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan generasi pemimpin masa depan MUF melalui pembelajaran yang terstruktur, pengalaman langsung di dunia kerja, serta pengembangan kompetensi kepemimpinan dan pemahaman bisnis secara menyeluruh. Dalam program ini, peserta akan mendapatkan kesempatan untuk mengikuti learning, cross-functional exposure, OJT, project implementation, evaluation, dan pengalaman langsung di unit bisnis. Melalui rangkaian pengalaman tersebut, peserta diharapkan mampu membangun leadership, business acumen, analytical thinking, collaboration, agility, dan execution capability sebagai bekal untuk menjalankan peran strategis di MUF. Untuk menghasilkan karya terbaik dan memberikan dampak positif bagi perusahaan, kami mencari talenta muda potensial yang memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, integritas tinggi, growth mindset, kemampuan analitis, inovatif, adaptif, serta antusias untuk terus belajar dan mendorong perubahan berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi : Sarjan

jobs.description: PT Rumah Sakit PELNI merupakan anak usaha milik perusahaan BUMN PT PELNI (Persero) yang bergerak pada bidang kesehatan. Sejak 16 Maret 2020, Rumah Sakit PELNI mewarnai sejarah pelayanan kesehatan kepada masyarakat Jakarta dan Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Rumah Sakit PELNI. Visi: Sebagai tempat terbaik untuk proses penyembuhan dan teman terpercaya dalam pelayanan kesehatan. Misi: Memberikan pelayanan dengan standar kualitas terbaik, terjangkau dalam lingkungan yang hijau dan nyaman dalam rangka membantu proses penyembuhan bagi setiap pasien dan keluarganya. Beberapa layanan unggulan saat ini yang telah mewarnai perjalanan Rumah Sakit PELNI adalah Layanan Jantung, Hemodialisa, Mata, Endokrin, Hati, Medical Check Up, Klinik Eksekutif Heritage, dan Diagnostic Center. Di mana seluruh aktivitas pelayanan di Rumah Sakit PELNI sudah terintegrasi secara menyeluruh dengan teknologi informasi buatan sendiri. Hal ini menjadi tonggak sejarah dalam catatan di penghujung umur 1 abad rumah sakit yang pernah dikenal sebagai Rumah Sakit Petamboeran ini, sebab penggunaan teknologi menjadi platform Rumah Sakit PELNI menyambut dan mengisi masa depan. Lowongan Kerja PT Rumah Sakit PELNI Saat ini PT Rumah Sakit PELNI membuka rekrutmen lowongan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Administrasi Pelayanan Pasien Persyaratan Umum : Pendidikan D3 Administrasi Rumah Sakit Fresh Graduate/Memiliki pengalaman dibidang Administrasi Rumah Sakit Memiliki Integritas yang tinggi dalam melaksanakan tugas Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift Mempunyai kemampuan komunikasi yang baik Mampu bekerja dengan baik secara individu maupun dalam tim Mampu bekerja dibawah tekanan dan sesuai target Mampu melakukan protokol kesehatan secara disiplin dan mandiri Persyaratan Khusus : Mampu berkomunikasi dan menangani keluhan Pasien terkait finansial Mampu untuk koordinasi ke pihak Perusahaan terkait penjaminan dan persetujuan tindakan 2. Logistics Persyaratan Umum: Pendidik
